units.name: Cavalry
units.description: Cavalry classes trade speed for mounted shock: Light Cavalry Charge 3 / Impact 0, Cavalry Charge 2 / Impact +1, and Heavy Cavalry Charge 1 / Impact +2. These are Unit-wide bonuses on a successful Charge, never per Model.

options.name: Light Cavalry
options.notes: Fast, lightly protected troops suited to harassment and flanking. Charge 3; Impact +0 on successful Charges (once per Unit).

options.name: Cavalry
options.notes: Conventional cavalry with balanced mobility and protection. Charge 2; Impact +1 on successful Charges (once per Unit).

options.name: Heavy Cavalry
options.notes: Durable shock cavalry with reduced movement. Charge 1; Impact +2 on successful Charges (once per Unit).

options.name: Mounted Weapons
options.notes: Swords, axes, maces, and conventional mounted weapons.

meleeWeapons.clarification: Heavy Mounted Weapons do not have the Heavy keyword; their increased cost accounts for their damage without preventing conventional mounted Charges.

rangedAndDefensiveEquipment.note: A Unit may take one ranged package in addition to its melee weapon. Shields may be purchased alongside a ranged package where physically appropriate.

options.name: No Additional Equipment
options.effect: Retain the chosen melee weapon without ranged or defensive upgrades.

options.name: Shields
options.restriction: Available to Cavalry and Heavy Cavalry using conventional melee weapons or Lances.

options.name: Standard Formation
options.effect: 3 Models using the selected Cavalry class and equipment.

options.name: Charge Formation
options.effect: 1 CP — Assault, when this Unit declares a Charge. Increase this Unit's one shared Charge Impact by +3 for that Charge. This is additive with its class Impact and applicable weapon Impact, but is not applied per Model. The Command grants neither a Charge nor an additional activation.

options.name: Additional Light Cavalry Model
options.effect: Add one matching Light Cavalry Model.

options.name: Additional Heavy Cavalry Model
options.effect: Add one matching Heavy Cavalry Model.

options.name: Weapon Specialization
options.effect: Choose one Faction, Unit Type, or Trait tag. One selected weapon gains Anti-[chosen tag] 2 against Units possessing it. Follows the normal Anti-[Type] rules (applies once to the Unit's combined Attack pool; does not stack with another applicable Anti-[Type] source on the same target — only the higher value counts). May be purchased once.

options.name: Veterans
options.effect: Increase Attacks by 1 per Model and improve Hit by one step.

options.name: Deadly Precision
options.effect: When this Unit declares a Weapon Attack during its own Assault or Combat activation, spend 1 CP. For each Surge generated by that Attack roll, convert up to one failed Hit die into a Critical Hit (Critical 1 per Surge); Critical Hits ignore Armor and Evade, but Ward applies. This Command works with any eligible weapon. It may be used on another eligible Attack for another 1 CP, but never twice on the same Attack. The Command does not grant an extra Attack or activation. This is explicitly Surge-dependent even though it is CP-paid: zero Surges means zero Critical conversions.

notes: Paid equipment incurs its additional per-Model cost.

units.battlefieldRole: Maneuver, Charges, flanking, and exploiting enemy weaknesses.
designNotes: v4 balance pass (post-playtesting): Damage-1 weapons (Mounted Weapons, Spears, Mounted Bows, Pistols, Carbines) gained +1 Attack; Damage-2 weapons (Lances, Heavy Mounted Weapons) kept their listed Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] 2.

v4.1 refinement: Cavalry's small 3-5 Model formation keeps a flat +50 Veterans cost, consistent with the new per-unit Veterans pricing philosophy (larger Infantry formations of 4-10 Models pay more). A new Weapon Specialization upgrade (+25) lets the Unit choose any Faction/Unit Type/Trait tag for a weapon to gain Anti-[chosen tag] 2, priced flat since Anti-[Type] applies once to the Unit's whole Attack pool regardless of Model count.
